name: OpenAI
description: San Francisco frontier lab behind ChatGPT, the GPT family, Sora and the OpenAI API.
longDescription: OpenAI began as a nonprofit research lab in 2015 and became the company that turned large language models into a mass-market product. ChatGPT, the GPT API, Codex and Sora now the consumer and enterprise surfaces; research still concentrates on reasoning, agents and multimodal systems. Microsoft remains the defining commercial partner.
